seoDescription: Learn how to customize your Ghost blog for an amazing look while embracing its powerful simplicity. This tutorial walks you through key design settings, from crafting a compelling site title and aspirational headline to optimizing your SEO with metadata. Discover how to change your accent color, upload a custom logo and favicon, and select the perfect homepage cover image using the built-in Unsplash integration. You'll also learn to configure font styles, logo placement, and post settings to create a professional and fast-loading website.

summary:
## Ghost's Customization Philosophy

Ghost intentionally offers minimal customization options. This is a feature, not a limitation, designed to help you focus on **strong messaging** and maintain a **fast-loading website** without getting overwhelmed by excessive choices.

## General Settings

Under the **General** tab, you can configure the foundational elements of your site:

*   **Title and Description:** Set the main name and tagline for your blog. You can change this at any time.
*   **Time Zone & Language:** Adjust these to match your location and primary audience.
*   **Metadata:** Customize the title and description that appear in Google search results. This is crucial for SEO.

> [!TIP]
> By default, Ghost uses your site title and description for metadata. Taking a moment to write a custom, keyword-rich meta description can improve your site's visibility on search engines.

## Homepage Design & Branding

Most of your site's visual identity is controlled in the **Design** panel.

*   **Aspirational Headline**: Replace the default site description with a powerful headline that speaks directly to your audience's goals (e.g., "Want to start a home-based business selling sports cards on eBay?").
*   **Cover Image**: You can remove the default cover, upload your own, or use the built-in **Unsplash** integration to add a high-quality, royalty-free image. You can set the cover to be full-screen or half-screen.
*   **Accent Color**: Choose a single accent color that will be used for buttons, links, and other highlights, creating a simple and consistent color scheme.
*   **Icon & Logo**: Upload a small **site icon (favicon)** for browser tabs and a **logo** to replace the default text-based site title on your homepage.

## Layout & Post Settings

Fine-tune the remaining details for a polished look and feel.

*   **Site-Wide Settings**: Control the **logo position** (left, middle, or stacked) and choose between two clean, pre-selected **font pairings** for your body and headings.
*   **Homepage Settings**: Adjust the feed layout and rename the "Featured articles" label.
*   **Post Settings**: Configure options for individual blog posts.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> It is recommended to keep both **"Show author name"** and **"Show related posts"** enabled. This adds credibility and helps keep readers engaged on your site.

## Key Takeaways

*   **Embrace simplicity**: Use Ghost's focused toolset to your advantage.
*   **Focus on messaging**: Your headline and content are more important than endless design tweaks.
*   **Use built-in tools**: Leverage features like the Unsplash integration to save time and add professional polish.
*   **Preview everywhere**: Always use the mobile preview toggle to ensure your site looks great on all devices.
